profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Cvent
profile.summary: I'm a pragmatic, polyglot programmer and full stack engineer. I've worked on various web applications, RESTful APIs, ELT data processing jobs, and multitier architectures. I am comfortable with Java, JavaScript, Python, and SQL, and I’m interested in opportunities to work with other programming languages. In addition to software development, I enjoy working with Linux systems and helping with configuration management and deployment automation. I have experience working in both on-premises and cloud environments.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Tysons Corner, Virginia, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Quality Engineer
positions.description: Working on an Enterprise Service Bus type project using Kafka and Kafka Streams to integrate data between different services.

positions.title: Senior Developer in Test
positions.description:
Transitioned from being a contractor to a staff member at FINRA working on the same team.

Worked with the team on the design of each application component as they were migrated to AWS. The types of components included data processing jobs, jobs to pull data from third-party vendors, REST APIs, web applications, and Elasticsearch clusters.

Performed the development, unit testing, and end-to-end testing of two components which pull data from third-party vendors.

Developed an end-to-end test framework in Java using Cucumber and Spring. Cucumber was used for organizing test data and executing tests. REST calls from the Cucumber tests to the Spring application would trigger tasks such as data setup, mocking server calls, executing jobs, and extracting data for validation.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Worked as a Contractor for FINRA in a SDET role. 

Created automated test suites for data processing jobs. 
Wrote protractor tests, found and fixed bugs in AngularJS applications.
Helped migrate a multitier application and corresponding data processing jobs off of Solaris and onto Linux servers.
Refactored existing Java code in order to add additional unit tests and improve test coverage.
Worked with the team to architect and design a cloud-based redesign for migrating application to AWS.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Value Added Services
August 2015 - Present
 
Working on a team developing SaaS products used internally at Verisign using Spring Boot, and supporting Verisign's DomainScope product. DomainScope helps people find domain names based on keywords, traffic, and recently expired domain names. 

My work so far includes:
 - Writing a Python alerting and monitoring script
 - Identifying and fixing bugs in existing prototypes for integration into DomainScope
 - Adding additional features to DomainScope back-end using Java

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
IOT PROJECT
June 2014 - August 2015

While working on this team, I was promoted to Software Engineer II.

This project was focused on exploring opportunities involving the Internet of Things using DNS-SD(Service Discovery). I worked as a full stack developer on a variety of tasks including:
 - Application architecture and design
 - Web portal, REST API, and SDK development
 - Configuration management and deployment orchestration
 - ELK configuration for logging management
 - Scrum master and end-of-sprint User Acceptance Testing
 
Web portal development included use of
- AngularJS and Bootstrap
- Jasmine, Karma, Protractor and Grunt for unit and functional test automation.

REST API development included use of
- Spring Boot, Spring JDBC templates, and Spring REST. 
- Integration tests of the REST API were done using Node.js and Mocha.

Configuration management and deployment orchestration were done using Ansible.

RAPID PROTOTYPING TEAM
Oct 2012 - June 2014

I worked on 6 prototypes while a member of this team. My work included:
- Client-side coding in JavaScript and HTML using Bootstrap, jQuery, jQueryUI, and AngularJS consuming RESTful APIs.
- Server-side coding in Java using Spring.
- iOS programming using Objective-C and Core Data.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Software Engineering, Web Application Development, Java, OOP
